title: Trapped Rainwater
prompt:
You are given a list of non-negative integers heights describing an elevation map, where each bar has width 1. After it rains, water collects in the dips between taller bars. Return the total units of water that are trapped. Water spills off both ends of the map.

Aim for O(n) time; O(1) extra space is possible with two pointers.

Example:
  trapped_water([3, 0, 2, 0, 4]) -> 7
  trapped_water([0, 1, 0, 2, 1, 0, 1, 3, 2, 1, 2, 1]) -> 6
